images.title: Espiral de supercúmulos
images.subject: A colossal asymmetrical spiral formed by THREE wide sweeping arms of galactic superclusters, not a single ordinary galaxy. Hundreds of tiny separately recognizable spiral galaxies and amber cores embedded in luminous indigo and violet cosmic web filaments. Large dark transparent gaps between the arms, eccentric empty center, elegant whirlpool silhouette, winding bright filaments and wispy ends. Dense sparkling amber centers within a predominantly royal blue / violet web.

images.title: Espuma de vacíos
images.subject: An immense cosmic foam of FIVE interconnected enormous irregular voids, like an organic network of hollow soap bubbles but made entirely of galactic walls. Each void interior is transparent, with delicate bright teal-blue filaments and countless tiny warm golden galaxies on the broken shell edges. A wide uneven cluster of connected hollow cavities of very different sizes. No smooth glass, no planets, no solid spheres: intricately shredded porous cosmic web with a spectacular honeycomb silhouette.

images.title: Marea cósmica
images.subject: One gigantic cosmic tidal wave: a folded sweeping curtain of cosmic matter, broad crescent sheet rising into one dramatic hooked crest on the left and unraveling into several long narrow filaments on the right. Thousands of tiny galaxy cores embedded in wispy gold-copper luminous ridges, cold cyan filaments along the torn edges and subtle wine-violet depth. Distinct horizontal breaking-wave silhouette, major transparent negative space under the curled crest, asymmetrical, majestic, not water, no ocean.

images.title: Nudo cósmico
images.subject: A colossal gravitational knot of TWO immense braided ribbons of galactic filaments, loosely twisting around each other with TWO large open loops and four irregular tapered ends. Unmistakable vertical interwoven silhouette, not a ring or a triangle. One ribbon electric blue with tiny white galaxies, the other amber-gold with lavender shadows; countless tiny spiral galaxy cores inside both ribbons. Delicate hairlike bridges between the ribbons, airy transparent openings. Natural uneven cosmic web structure, not metal or solid rope.
